summary: On the managing tenant you choose, per admin and per group, exactly which managed tenants receive it.

new.title: Choose which managed tenants receive each item
new.text: On the managing tenant, every admin, membership, group and binding can say whether it replicates, and to which tenants by ring, tag or name.

new.title: See how many tenants it reaches
new.text: The Create wizards and the grid show "This will reach: N of M tenants" before you commit, with the names on hover.

fixes.title: MSP settings show only where they matter
fixes.text: A single tenant no longer shows sync settings, and a managed tenant shows read-only which admins it received.

fixes.title: Groups arrive with their memberships
fixes.text: Department, project and cross-org groups are now sent along with the memberships that need them, and items kept local stay local.

fixes.title: Removals are reported first
fixes.text: A row that stops reaching a managed tenant is reported as would remove and removed only when you allow it.
fixes.action: If a managed tenant's sync relied on stale rows being removed automatically, run it with removal explicitly allowed.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The managing tenant's view of which tenants an admin reaches is accurate, and admin assignments have a Target column in the grid.
